title: projectGameCredential
responsibility: Read a game-specific provider key only from the selected project ignored regular credential file.

inputs.name: projectGameCredential.root
inputs.description: Selected game project directory used for Git ignore checks and credential file access.

inputs.name: projectGameCredential.name
inputs.description: Dedicated game provider environment-variable name to read from the project credential file.

outputs.name: projectGameCredential
outputs.description: Provider key from the selected ignored regular project file; never an ambient or other-project fallback.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Required project key is missing, tracked, unignored, unreadable or stored through a non-regular file.
